scope: Corollary 10.12 (Completion of the height assertions) of the manuscript “BKT universality for height and planar spin fields” (preprints/BKT-universality-for-height-and-planar-spin-fields-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 216 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 5e6a8df09e021c4a), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 166. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For every admissible finite-range J, the uniquely determined effective temperature is βeff(J, β) = v2 J a(β/v2 J ), β ≥ βc(J). It has the field, Laplace-functional, and tightness conclusions in Theorem 1.1, is differentiable for β > βc(J), and satisfies βeff(J, βc(J)) = 8πv2 J , lim β↓βc(J) βeff(J, β) − βeff(J, βc(J)) β − βc(J) = +∞. Its high-temperature normalization and spread-out onset are βeff(J, β) = β + OJ (e−cJ β ), βc(Jρ) 8πv2 Jρ −→ 1. For nearest neighbors the endpoint value is 2π.
